fato_historico: 2001: The Taliban held city of Mazar-i-Sharif falls to the Northern Alliance under generals Abdul Rashid Dostum and Atta Muhammad Nur.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a powerful shift, Aries, mirroring the way walls tumble when the time for liberation arrives. It is a good time to consider how you can reclaim your own territory of peace. Like a resilient four-leaf clover pushing through dry earth, your boldness may turn stagnant situations into fresh opportunities for your personal growth and victory.
frase_do_dia: Your courage is the key that unlocks the door to your brightest future.
significado_numero: Represents intuition and the alignment of your true purpose and energy.
conselho: Trust your instincts and move forward with the confidence of a true pioneer.
